summary: 电影《给阿嬷的情书》在泰国及港澳、新马文莱等地引发共鸣。“侨批”是早年海外华侨将家书与汇款一同寄回故里的特殊载体，2013年入选联合国教科文组织《世界记忆名录》。在马来西亚华人博物馆、马六甲南洋体验馆、新加坡国家图书馆等地，侨批被收藏展示，
summary_en: The film 'Love Letter to Grandma' has resonated in Thailand, Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, Malaysia, Brunei and other places. 'Qiaopi' are special remittance letters that overseas Chinese in earlier times sent home together with money, and were inscribed in UNESCO's Memory of the World Register in 2013. title_en: "Stable electricity makes production and daily life more convenient"
summary: 中国企业投资建设的乌兹别克斯坦奇尔100兆瓦/200兆瓦时储能项目已全面商业运营。该项目位于塔什干州奇尔奇克市，为首都地区首批独立电网侧储能项目之一。作为大型“绿色充电宝”，它在新能源发电富余时储能、用电高峰时释放，发挥削峰填谷、调频调压作

summary_en: Sinopec Petroleum Engineering Construction Company is building the sixth and seventh sections of the third phase pipeline project of Saudi Arabia's national natural gas pipeline network, with a total length of about 700 kilometers. Upon completion, it will form the main artery for Saudi Arabia's east-to-west gas transmission, enhancing gas transmission capacity. The project uses intelligent equipment such as domestically produced automatic welding machines, with welding precision measured in millimeters. Overall progress exceeds 80%, and over 678 kilometers of pipeline welding has been completed.
